_comment: SPEC-APP.md §8.3-§8.5 eval-harness config (APP-022, #134). penalties: asymmetric trichotomy weights — incorrect must be strictly worse than abstained, which must not exceed correct (enforced at runtime by gate.ts's assertValidGateConfig, not just by convention here). adjudicationCriticalMaxIncorrectRate: §8.5(a)'s near-zero threshold. perSuiteMinCorrectRate: §8.5(b)'s per-suite coverage floor — every one of the eight suites must have an entry (loud failure otherwise); ood-rejection/abstention-quality are set high because the ONLY correct behavior there is abstaining/refusing, so a well-behaved model should clear a high bar. calibration: §9.7/§10.9 inputs to calibration.ts's calibrate(). rubricJudge: the real transport is qa/engine.ts's TeacherClient abstraction (see scorers/rubricJudge.ts) — 'engine' selects which of its two engines a future real (non --stub) run would use; --stub mode (the only mode `npm run gate` exercises) never reads this.
